mod.name: AdvancedExpPotionSystem
mod.author: MatheusMkalo
mod.config:
configs = { time = 120, ---- TIME IN MINUTES needpa = TRUE, needlvl = {FALSE, level = 50}, costmana = {FALSE, mana = 300}, addrate = 100, -- Exp que vai adicionar em % removeonuse = TRUE, storage = 62164 }
-- Fixed: old code used arg[1] as creature, but arg[1] was the callback function. -- So every scheduled end/reset never ran and double XP stayed forever. CreatureEventChecker = function(event, ...) local args = {...} if args[1] and isCreature(args[1]) then event(unpack(args)) end end
creatureEvent = function(event, delay, ...) addEvent(CreatureEventChecker, delay, event, ...) end
function getPlayerExtraExpRate(cid) return (getPlayerRates(cid)[8] - 1) * 100 end
function endExpPotion(cid, baseRate) doPlayerSetExperienceRate(cid, baseRate) setPlayerStorageValue(cid, configs.storage, 0) doPlayerSendCancel(cid, "The effect of the exp potion end.") end
function scheduleExpPotionCountdown(cid, minutesLeft) minutesLeft = math.floor(minutesLeft) if minutesLeft < 1 then return end for i = minutesLeft, 1, -1 do local a = i .. ":00" if #a < 4 then a = string.sub(a, 1, 2) .. "0" .. string.sub(a, 3) end local delay = (minutesLeft - i) * 60 * 1000 creatureEvent( doPlayerSendCancel, delay, cid, "The effect of the exp potion will end in " .. a .. "." ) end end
mod.action:
domodlib('PotionExpConfigs') if getPlayerStorageValue(cid, configs.storage) >= 1 then return doPlayerSendCancel(cid, "You are already taking effect from this item.") end
if configs.needpa and not isPremium(cid) then return doPlayerSendCancel(cid, "You need to be a premmium account to use this item.") end
if configs.needlvl[1] and getPlayerLevel(cid) < configs.needlvl.level then return doPlayerSendCancel(cid, "You need to be level " .. configs.needlvl.level .. " to use this item.") end
if configs.costmana[1] then if getCreatureMana(cid) < configs.costmana.mana then return doPlayerSendCancel(cid, "You need " .. configs.costmana.mana .. " mana to use this item.") end doCreatureAddMana(cid, -configs.costmana.mana) end
if configs.removeonuse then doRemoveItem(item.uid, 1) end
local baseRate = getPlayerRates(cid)[8] local duration = configs.time * 60 * 1000 doPlayerSetExperienceRate(cid, baseRate + (configs.addrate / 100)) setPlayerStorageValue(cid, configs.storage, os.time()) scheduleExpPotionCountdown(cid, configs.time) creatureEvent(endExpPotion, duration, cid, baseRate) doPlayerSendTextMessage(cid, 22, "Agora voce ira receber mais exp por matar os mosntros.") return TRUE
mod.creaturescript:
domodlib('PotionExpConfigs') local stored = getPlayerStorageValue(cid, configs.storage) if stored < 1 then return TRUE end
local remaining = (configs.time * 60) - (os.time() - stored) if remaining <= 0 then setPlayerStorageValue(cid, configs.storage, 0) return TRUE end
local baseRate = getPlayerRates(cid)[8] doPlayerSetExperienceRate(cid, baseRate + (configs.addrate / 100)) scheduleExpPotionCountdown(cid, math.ceil(remaining / 60)) creatureEvent(endExpPotion, remaining * 1000, cid, baseRate) return TRUE
